write_up: This is a common early-career resume: you have a Cardinal Health software internship, help desk work, and projects that point toward Software Engineer roles. But the internship mostly lists activities rather than the features and fixes you worked on, so a recruiter is likely to move on without knowing what you can bring to the job.

The Personal Finance Tracker line is a good model: it names the application, what it does, and the tools you used. Your help desk role also gives you substantial experience, so put Experience above Education. Your May 2026 graduation accounts for time after the internship.

Let's start with the Cardinal Health role. Name the inventory features, tests, and bugs you worked on, using details you can stand behind. Then trim the generic objective and give the help desk work a little more detail.
